items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: I liked Professor Longhair, of course.

ctx.x: I liked all records, all the records that are out here. And I liked Ranky Tank type pianos. I liked Fats Waller. I liked Professor Longhair, of course. Ray Charles. Lloyd Glenn. Albert Hammond. By Albert Hammond. Fuck like that.
Did you go to, I think it was a green high school with James Rivers? I think you were like a year or two ahead of him. I think an Art Neville and James Black.

items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: because Al Toussaint got a little studio in there.

ctx.x: Yeah. Do you ever know a guitar player around here? He's supposed to still be around here. His name is, uh, his name is Walter Nelson. Yeah, that's the one, that's Papoose. That's Papoose? He's dead. He's dead? Yeah. I know. Yeah, Dissa, uh, Sheik told me that, uh, that, uh, he didn't know if he was dead or not. He didn't know where he was or anything like that. Yeah, he did. And I was, uh, Walter Nelson Senior is still living.

Well, they're down there around St. Philip and St. Claude. If you ever go around the Caledonia Inn around that section, you find a bunch of musicians still, you know, around there because Al Toussaint got a little studio in there. Yeah. Yeah. And they all go around there. Still think they got a change.
Allen, Allen's, uh, do pretty good I think. That's in, uh, yeah.
